tools.name: pypi_wheel_evidence
tools.description: Reports provider-reported filename/tag intersection for PyPI wheels; it does not perform compatibility, security, or digest verification.

tools.name: network_set_evidence
tools.description: Compares bounded mathematical IPv4 and IPv6 address sets and reports canonical normalized, added, removed, count, and witness evidence; it does not assess reachability, routing, security policy, configuration, or host usability.
